segments.title: Stop saying "make it better"
segments.say: Stop telling AI to make it better.

segments.title: AI can't read your mind
segments.say: It has no idea what better means to you.

segments.title: Give it 3 things
segments.say: Give it a reader, a limit, and a rule.
Rewrite this for busy readers. Cut thirty percent. Keep every fact. Then list what you cut and why.
segments.text: Rewrite this for busy readers. Cut 30%. Keep every fact. Then list what you cut and why.

segments.title: Now you can check it
segments.say: That last line lets you check its work instead of trusting it.
segments.text: Here's the shorter version… And here's what I cut, and why:

segments.say: Save this, and follow for one prompt a day.
